summary: B6 Session 3 — Conversational Event Edit UI frontend test. 8/9 P0 scenarios PASS end-to-end against live Emergent LLM. Every new Session 3 UI element renders and behaves exactly as designed: (P0-1) 'Ask George to edit this event' Pressable + subtext 'Just tell George what to change — no forms.' shows on /events/edit/[id]; (P0-2) tapping it opens the George modal with the composer prefilled with `Help me edit my "Coffee Catch-Up" event`; (P0-3) compact single-field card renders `TIME 2pm → 3pm` with Confirm + Keep as is chips; (P0-4) tapping Confirm sends 'yes please', shows APPLIED card + `Undo · 29s` countdown chip, Mongo time flips to 15:00; (P0-5) tapping Undo within 30s sends 'undo that', reverts to 14:00 with 'Done — I've reverted the last change on Coffee Catch-Up.'; (P0-6) multi-field full card renders DATE/TIME/LOCATION with strike-through OLD → arrow-down → bold NEW; (P0-8) cancel intent shows danger-styled 'Cancel Coffee Catch-Up' card with a red 'Yes, cancel it' button (RGB DC2626), tapping Keep as is leaves cancelled=False; (P0-9) low-risk description edit auto-applies with 'Done — I've updated the description…' bubble + APPLIED card + Undo chip (no confirm pair, as designed). The ONE partial is P0-7: sending 'actually change the date to next Monday' auto-applied the date change instantly (no awaiting_confirm card) — this is a **backend classification** decision, not a Session 3 UI regression. The UI path is provably correct because a) P0-3 & P0-6 both surface high-risk confirm cards, and b) P0-9 surfaces the auto-apply card. P1 regression scenarios 10 & 11 could not be exercised via the top-header teal butterfly (opening via mouse coord tap on /home did not fire the open handler in web preview); this is likely a testID coverage gap rather than a bug — see action_items. No red-screen errors, no React warnings other than pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation notices and one benign 'GO_BACK not handled' warning caused by the Ask George row calling router.back() when the edit screen was reached via direct URL.

minor.issue: Sending 'actually change the date to next Monday' after the edit context was established was auto-applied by the backend instead of entering awaiting_confirm. The session 2 design brief flags date as high-risk. Not confirmed as regression against the 9/9 suite — could be a heuristic difference when the LLM sees 'actually change'.

Low-risk description edit REPLACED the existing description entirely with the new snippet ('A gentle catch-up over coffee.' → 'mention parking is limited') instead of appending. Session 3 UI still renders correctly (APPLIED card with strike-through old → bold new); flagging in case product wants merge-append semantics for description.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings for 'shadow*' style props (should be boxShadow) and 'textShadow*' (should be textShadow). Legacy warnings not introduced by Session 3.

Ask George row calls router.back() unconditionally; when the edit screen was reached via deep-link with no history, RN Navigation logs 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' warning. Recommend guarding with router.canGoBack() before calling back(). Reference: /app/frontend/app/events/edit/[id].tsx:191

action_items: OPTIONAL: guard router.back() with router.canGoBack() in /app/frontend/app/events/edit/[id].tsx L191 to silence the GO_BACK warning when the edit screen is deep-linked.

OPTIONAL: add a stable testID to the top-header teal butterfly (currently unfindable by testID). e.g. testID="george-butterfly-header" so E2E tests can open George without pixel coords. Would unblock the P1-10/P1-11 regression pass.

PRODUCT DECISION (backend): confirm whether date field is still supposed to be high-risk (awaiting_confirm). Today, 'actually change the date to next Monday' auto-applies. If intended, add unit coverage; if not, tighten the classifier.
PRODUCT DECISION (backend): decide whether description edits should append vs replace — today they replace. Session 3 UI supports either.
critical_code_review_comments: EventChangeSummaryCard.tsx is well factored (~500 lines, single-responsibility, theme-aware). The `useEffect` cleanup in AppliedCard correctly clears the 250ms interval on unmount. `isUndo` guard prevents infinite undo loops.
george-context.tsx correctly serialises pendingOpener consumption via consumePendingOpener() so the opener can't be double-fired.

events/edit/[id].tsx: minor — the ask-george row is only guarded by !ev.cancelled but relies on parent already gating isHost || isAdmin; that's correct today but the pattern is fragile if the parent check ever regresses.

success_rate.backend: n/a — not re-tested (9/9 per session brief)
success_rate.frontend: 8/9 P0 scenarios PASS (P0-7 blocked by backend auto-apply behaviour, not UI); P1 regression not exercised due to header butterfly lacking testID

seed_data_creation: None persistent. Mongo state reset via /tmp/reset_event.py between each destructive scenario. Final state: description='A gentle catch-up over coffee.', date=2026-08-04, time=14:00, location='Community Hall', cancelled=False, event_edits cleared, george_event_conversations cleared for Alex.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: mobile-web preview at http://localhost:3000/. From the FriendPlace welcome screen tap 'Log In' (case sensitive — 'Log In' with capital I, then the on-form submit is 'Log in' with lowercase i). Login placeholders are lowercase: 'username or email' and 'Your password'. To exercise the edit flow open /events/edit/62217b94-b6ee-45de-834c-912040e58dd3 and tap the 'Ask George to edit this event' Pressable (testID="ask-george-to-edit"). Composer placeholder is 'Tell George anything…'. To reset Mongo between destructive scenarios run `python /tmp/reset_event.py`. Emergent LLM turns take 5-9s; use ≥30s per-turn timeouts. Undo chip has a client-side 30s countdown — click before it expires. The top-header teal butterfly (opens George from /home etc.) has no stable testID; pixel-tap coords do not reliably fire the RN Pressable in the web preview.
rca_of_issue: P0-7: 'actually change the date to next Monday' was applied instantly with George saying 'Done — Coffee Catch-Up is now on Monday 27 July.' No confirm card rendered. The UI would have rendered the confirm card correctly (proven by P0-3, P0-6, P0-8) — the backend simply did not emit `edit.kind=='edit_awaiting_confirm'` for this specific turn. Not a Session 3 UI regression.
